inlines.text: This conference programme was designed for a very wide screen. The text is tiny, at nine pixels, and every column is seven hundred pixels wide. On a phone none of this should matter: the reader ignores widths and floors the font size.
Second column, even smaller at eight pixels. Session times: 09:00 keynote, 10:30 workshops, 12:00 lunch, 13:30 panels and 16:00 closing remarks.
Fine print in six points that never wraps in the original: registration fees are non-refundable after 1 November 2026.
